claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single fixed total certificate-free language in family.py and proof.md. For N>=2 let L=floor(log2 N), J=ceil(log2(L+2)), k=floor(2^10000*L^13/J); k>N or failed exact metadata guards return zero. Set m=floor(k/(2^300 L^2)), h=pow2ceil(2^200 L^2), ell=2^300 L^2, d=2^64*(h^3*ell+L), E=2^200 L^2. A supplied bounded-order diagonal-orbit linear extractor provides Short and all long calls with their exact paid entropy thresholds. Indexed alternating extraction and the monotone polynomial-graph resilient map with delta=1/2^20 supply the output. All N bits are payload; every field and ordering is uniform, with no advice or witness input. Runtime is one fixed polynomial with an enormous degree.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"kind":"big_o","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"13"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"-1"}}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exist fixed K>0 and N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-K*(log2 N)^13/(log2 log2 N) for every integer actual length N>=N0 in the full pinned B2 model. The supplied complete bounded-order diagonal extraction, correlation, resilience and fixed-factor accounting prove affine dispersal at the exact k, and the full kernel gives 4N-8k. This same complete guarantee implies the joint finite projection (4,1).","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact arithmetic, field and older orbit toys, folded rank, graph intersections, covariance and Bonferroni; added bounded-order search and small diagonal Vandermonde checks. Actual full-family tests use only zero guards. None certifies universal extraction, conditioning or the full-B2 theorem.
